title: Mastering Your Circumstances: Lessons from a Russian Count
summary: President Hughes delays his planned series on the science of habits due to a need for better visuals, promising to share it in a few weeks. Instead, he reviews a novel about a Russian count confined to the Metropole Hotel for 20 years during the Communist Revolution, using the count's humility and adaptation to illustrate the quote, 'If you don't master your circumstances, they will master you.'
